what: A zigzag band of alternating upright bars and diagonally joined panels is built starting .8s after opening, from the left cell, at .13s intervals. Bars rise from the floor (scaleY 0→1, .18s), diagonal panels open from the left edge to the right (clip-path, .18s), and both turn on from transparent (cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94)). Only the last bar settles down long at 1s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), so the band looks drawn in one stroke and then the end seems to catch its breath

options.last-ease: Curve for the last step, default .23,1,.32,1
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: Upright bar — rises from the baseline
options.[data-fx-part=diag]: Diagonal panel — the end shape is the clip-path: polygon(four points) in the consuming CSS. The start is folded onto the left edge (points 1 and 4)

use: …
note: The original wrote animation-delay directly on each cell’s css keyframes (squigglebar, squigglediagonal). The part assigns delays in cell order. With reduced motion, it shows the fully built band

from.where: index.html Hero .i-zig (original hero seven cells: .8s · .93s · 1.06s · 1.19s · 1.32s · 1.45s for .18s, last at 1.58s for 1s), the same band in the closing sections of product.html · service.html
